name: NetAPI (compromised-check API and compromised IP/domain feeds)
tier_rationale: P150 final condition 1: terms 'unknown' and tier unknown until legal records them. Disabled in every profile until then; afterwards opt-in, excluded at AMBER and above, --allow-unknown at CLEAR/GREEN, IOC_TYPES only.

reliability.justification: Compromised-host feed from honeypot sensors plus a re-published domain warning list (CERT Polska, sinkhole name servers); one vote at most, never above LOW alone (P150 FC3/FC4).

error_markers.reason: NetAPI: error object in an HTTP 200 body

check.title: NetAPI compromised-check (GET https://netapi.com/api-json/?method=compromised-check&value=...): listed now / ever in the compromised feeds
check.notes: P150 FC1/FC2: terms not reviewed. Used only when the local feed copy is absent (local first). URL inputs send only the host name. Invalid value: HTTP 400 {error:{code:'invalid_value'}} -> ERROR. The answers name the feed licence ('CC BY 4.0'), recorded as evidence for legal only.

compromised_ip.title: NetAPI compromised IP feed (one IPv4 per line, updated hourly), matched locally
compromised_ip.notes: P150 FC2: matched locally (disclosure 'none'); once legal records the terms it becomes a feed of P149 (ip_blocklists) instead of per-IP calls. The check answers state 'NetAPI Nightwatch compromised IP feed, updated hourly (CC BY 4.0)' - evidence for the legal review, not a terms decision.

compromised_domains.title: NetAPI compromised domain feed (CSV domain,threat_type,evidence,first_seen,last_seen; ~20 MB, daily), matched locally
compromised_domains.notes: P150 FC2: large dataset (> 5 MB): fetched only by `v3lum data update`, never mid-scan. Exact FQDN matching only (rows on shared platforms such as *.pages.dev never flag the platform). 'sinkhole-*' rows are sinkholed names (context), 'cert-polska' rows re-publish the CERT Polska warning list (counted as that family).

notes: Owned by batch p3-G02-2 (P150 ip_reputation_keyless, netapi_compromised_feeds).
